name: B10-0229/2025 (PPE) – Immediate risk of further repression by Lukashenka’s regime in Belarus - threats from the Investigative Committee
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the immediate risk of further repression by Lukashenka’s regime in Belarus – threats from the Investigative Committee
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union and its member states to act against Belarus's crackdown on its own people, at home and abroad. It asks for targeted sanctions on officials responsible, better legal protection and visa access for Belarusians in exile, and continued support for independent activists, journalists and lawyers. It also demands an end to politically motivated charges and the release of all political prisoners. This is a statement of position and requests; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; it is a set of demands to the European Union and member states.
- **Who it affects:** Belarusian officials under sanctions, and Belarusians in exile or in prison.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to European Union leaders and member states for follow-up.
